descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S21 「手机宽度和 WebKit 上的 Save & Extract 和任务列表」 Save & Extract and the task list on phone width and WebKit

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). …（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Visual-lane profiles pixel7 (Chromium) and iphone15 (WebKit)

When Open the Encounter tab with the 1,213-character S10 text in the box, then Post-Round → Tasks with a 120-character task

Then Save & Extract stays visible and tappable (not covered, at least 24 px); task texts wrap, nothing cut off or overflowing

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual-lane findings covered/overflow/truncated/tap = 0 on these screens (findings go to a human)

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S21

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：encounter.spec.ts (phones only): Encounter with the 1,213-character LONG TEXT + closing sentence: Save & Extract uncovered/enabled/>= 24 px; Post-Round → tasks with the 120-character task: wraps, nothing cut off. [2026-10-14 review] Both captures judge overflow, covered, truncated and tap ≥ 24 px (the oracle names all four).
